content:
mira: Heads-up — I'm taking the 14:00 UTC slot on the release train today. Planning a quiet cutover, 20m canary then full wave. Who's pairing with me for smoke and rollback watch?

sam: I can do smoke pairing for the 14:00 slot, on call until 15:30. Will monitor metrics and watch traces. @mira ping me 10m before. :ok_hand:

jordan: I'll be the rollback owner if things look flaky — I can run the rollback playbook and coordinate DB toggles.

li: I'll run the smoke checklist and perf probes. Can you drop the smoke runbook link? want to pre-run locally before 14:00.

mira: quick runbook snippet below — should be all we need for the initial validation:
```
# smoke steps (14:05 start)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/_smoke?env=staging 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"route":"chat.generate","prompt":"smoke-check"}'
# check /metrics latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%
```

sam: nice. I'll tail logs and hit the same endpoint from our infra subnet to match production egress.

alex: FYI product will do a quick sanity on the main path at 14:10. If you get any regressions, flag them in this thread and we can hold traffic.

mira: noted. Quick questions: 1) any DB migrations in this wave? 2) feature flags to toggle?

jordan: No DB migrations. One feature flag (chat-regen) — currently off in staging. If smoke looks good we flip for 10% then 100%. I'll coordinate the toggle.

li: I'll execute the smoke checklist at 14:05 and post results here (pass/fail + samples). I have a small script to capture traces.

sam: Also can we confirm rollback steps? Jordan — what's the expected RTO if we fully rollback?

jordan: Target RTO 8 minutes for full rollback (scale down new variant, switch routing, revert flag). Will need two approvals: deploy lead + infra oncall. I'll call it in this thread.

mira: Good. I'm adding a tiny preflight at 13:50 — sanity deploy dry-run (no traffic). Quick request: @deploy-bot, lock the wave and reserve 14:00 slot for team redwood/eng-releases.

deploy-bot: wave-lock: reserved slot 14:00 UTC for thread 1809994444. Autoscaler paused for reservation window.

li: preflight done at 13:50 locally — smoke script executed, traces look good. Ready.

sam: on my side: log watchers in place, alerts pinned. Will post a few metric samples during canary.

alex: product standing by for the 14:10 sanity check. If smoke passes, we proceed with 10% flag flip at 14:12.

mira: plan summary: 14:00 deploy start -> 14:05 smoke -> 14:10 product sanity -> 14:12 flag 10% -> monitor 10m -> scale to 100% by 14:25 if green. Rollback if any step fails, Jordan leads.

jordan: copy. I'll post rollback command snippets in case we need them.

mira: thanks all — tagging final ack: @sam @jordan @li @alex :thumbsup:. Post any late blockers here and we'll delay if needed.

sam: ack :thumbsup:

jordan: ack

deploy-bot: deploy-queue: release 2026-03-18T14:00Z queued; status=reserved; owners=[mira,sam,jordan];
